statements.text: BERT stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers.
GPT stands for General Pretrained Transformer.
statements.correction: GPT stands for Generative Pre-trained Transformer.

statements.text: The Transformer architecture was introduced by Google researchers in the paper "Attention Is All You Need".
Meta created the Llama family of open-weight models.
Gemini models are built by Google DeepMind.
Mistral AI, the company behind Le Chat, is headquartered in Berlin.
statements.correction: Mistral AI is headquartered in Paris.

statements.text: OpenAI's HumanEval benchmark contains 1,640 hand-written programming problems.
statements.correction: HumanEval contains 164 hand-written programming problems.

statements.text: The MMLU benchmark covers 57 subjects, including mathematics, US history, computer science and law.
SWE-bench is built from real GitHub issues in 12 popular Python repositories.
DeepMind's AlphaGo beat Go champion Lee Sedol 4 games to 1.
AlphaFold, the protein structure prediction system, was built by OpenAI.
statements.correction: AlphaFold was built by DeepMind, now Google DeepMind.

statements.text: OpenAI Five beat OG, the reigning Dota 2 world champions.
The JAX numerical computing library was developed by Microsoft Research.
statements.correction: JAX was developed by Google.

statements.text: TensorFlow was developed by the Google Brain team.
PyTorch was originally developed at Facebook AI Research, now part of Meta.
Meta's Llama 3.1 models support a context length of 128K tokens.
The Claude 3 model family launched with a 200K token context window.
Google tested Gemini 1.5 Pro on context windows of up to 100 million tokens in research.
statements.correction: Google tested Gemini 1.5 Pro on up to 10 million tokens in research.

statements.text: Claude Code is Anthropic's agentic coding tool that runs in the terminal.
OpenAI's Codex CLI is an open-source coding agent that runs locally in the terminal.
Google's Gemini CLI is open source under the MIT License.
statements.correction: Gemini CLI is open source under the Apache 2.0 License.

statements.text: Demis Hassabis and John Jumper won a share of the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein structure prediction.
Yoshua Bengio, Geoffrey Hinton and Yann LeCun received the Turing Award for their work on deep learning.
Geoffrey Hinton shared the Nobel Prize in Physics with Yann LeCun.
statements.correction: Hinton shared the Nobel Prize in Physics with John Hopfield.

statements.text: The Qwen family of language models is developed by Alibaba Cloud.
The Kimi K2 model is developed by Moonshot AI.
The GLM family of models is developed by DeepSeek.
statements.correction: The GLM models are developed by Zhipu AI, also known as Z.ai.

statements.text: FlashAttention speeds up attention by cutting reads and writes to GPU memory.
Multi-query attention, where all heads share one set of keys and values, was proposed by Noam Shazeer.
The base Transformer model in "Attention Is All You Need" used 12 attention heads.
statements.correction: The base Transformer model used 8 attention heads.

statements.text: GPT-3 has 175 billion parameters.
BLOOM, the open multilingual model from the BigScience project, has 176 billion parameters.
The largest Llama 3.1 model has 450 billion parameters.
statements.correction: The largest Llama 3.1 model has 405 billion parameters.

statements.text: The Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, for agents to talk to each other, was announced by Google.
Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients and servers exchange JSON-RPC 2.0 messages.
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) was introduced by OpenAI.
statements.correction: MCP was introduced by Anthropic.

statements.text: Libratus, an AI built at Carnegie Mellon University, beat top professional poker players.
DeepMind's AlphaStar reached Grandmaster level in StarCraft II.
IBM's Deep Blue lost its rematch against chess champion Garry Kasparov.
statements.correction: Deep Blue won its rematch against Kasparov.

statements.text: Movie Gen is a set of media generation models from Meta.
Veo is a video generation model from Google DeepMind.
Kling, the AI video generation model, is made by ByteDance.
statements.correction: Kling is made by Kuaishou.

statements.text: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) was introduced in a paper from Facebook AI Research.
Constitutional AI, a method for training AI with a list of principles, was published by Anthropic.
Chain-of-thought prompting was introduced in a paper by Meta AI researchers.
statements.correction: Chain-of-thought prompting was introduced by Google researchers.

statements.text: Humanity's Last Exam was created by the Center for AI Safety and Scale AI.
The GSM8K math benchmark was created by OpenAI.
The MATH benchmark of competition problems was created by OpenAI.
statements.correction: MATH was created by researchers at UC Berkeley.

statements.text: DeepSeek-V3 has 671 billion total parameters, with 37 billion active for each token.
Mixtral 8x7B has 8 experts per layer and sends each token to 2 of them.
Google's Switch Transformer sends each token to 2 experts.
statements.correction: Switch Transformer sends each token to a single expert.

statements.text: Comet is an AI web browser made by Perplexity.
ChatGPT Atlas is a web browser made by OpenAI.
The Dia AI browser is made by Opera.
statements.correction: Dia is made by The Browser Company, the makers of Arc.

statements.text: NVIDIA's Blackwell GPU architecture is named after the mathematician David Blackwell.
Ironwood is Google's seventh-generation TPU.
NVIDIA's H100 GPU is built on the Ampere architecture.
statements.correction: The H100 is built on the Hopper architecture.

statements.text: DeepSeek-R1-Zero was trained with large-scale reinforcement learning, without supervised fine-tuning first.
OpenAI o1 ranked in the 89th percentile on Codeforces competitive programming questions.
OpenAI named its next reasoning model after o1 "o2".
statements.correction: OpenAI skipped the name o2 and named the next model o3.

statements.text: Claude Opus 4.5 scored 80.9% on SWE-bench Verified.
GPT-5 scored 74.9% on SWE-bench Verified.
Gemini 2.5 Pro scored 83.8% on SWE-bench Verified.
statements.correction: At launch, Gemini 2.5 Pro scored 63.8% on SWE-bench Verified with a custom agent.

statements.text: OpenAI's gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b open-weight models use the Apache 2.0 license.
Mistral 7B was released under the Apache 2.0 license.
Meta released Llama 2 under the Apache 2.0 license.
statements.correction: Llama 2 uses Meta's own Llama 2 Community License.

statements.text: Word2vec was introduced by researchers at Google.
ResNet, the deep residual network for image recognition, came from Microsoft Research.
Generative adversarial networks (GANs) were introduced by researchers at OpenAI.
statements.correction: GANs were introduced by Ian Goodfellow and others at the Université de Montréal.

statements.text: wav2vec 2.0, a model that learns speech from raw audio, was developed by Facebook AI.
Meta's SeamlessM4T is a single model for speech and text translation in up to 100 languages.
OpenAI trained the original Whisper model on 68,000 hours of audio.
statements.correction: The original Whisper was trained on 680,000 hours of audio.

statements.text: vLLM was first developed in the Sky Computing Lab at UC Berkeley.
GGUF, a file format for model weights, was created by the developer of llama.cpp.
The safetensors format for storing model weights was created by Google.
statements.correction: safetensors was created by Hugging Face.

statements.text: Google DeepMind's AlphaProof proves math statements in the formal language Lean.
An advanced version of Gemini Deep Think reached gold-medal level at the International Mathematical Olympiad.
Google DeepMind's AlphaProof and AlphaGeometry 2 reached gold-medal level at the International Mathematical Olympiad.
statements.correction: AlphaProof and AlphaGeometry 2 reached silver-medal level, solving four of six problems.

statements.text: Anthropic's Claude 3 family had three models: Haiku, Sonnet and Opus.
Google's first Gemini model came in three sizes: Ultra, Pro and Nano.
OpenAI's GPT-4o family has three models: GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini and GPT-4o nano.
statements.correction: There is no GPT-4o nano. OpenAI's first nano model was GPT-4.1 nano.

statements.text: Meta pretrained Llama 3 on over 15 trillion tokens.
The Pile, an open dataset from EleutherAI, is 825 GiB of English text.
Hugging Face's FineWeb dataset has about 150 trillion tokens.
statements.correction: FineWeb launched with about 15 trillion tokens and has since grown to about 18.5 trillion.

statements.text: GitHub Copilot was first powered by OpenAI Codex.
Junie is the AI coding agent made by JetBrains.
Amazon's agentic coding IDE is called Jules.
statements.correction: Amazon's agentic IDE is Kiro. Jules is Google's coding agent.

statements.text: The Vision Transformer paper is titled "An Image is Worth 16x16 Words".
OpenAI trained CLIP on 400 million image and text pairs.
Meta's SA-1B dataset for Segment Anything has 11 million masks.
statements.correction: SA-1B has over 1 billion masks on 11 million images.

statements.text: The ARC-AGI benchmark was created by François Chollet.
A preview of OpenAI's o3 scored 75.7% on the ARC-AGI-1 Semi-Private set in its high-efficiency setting.
ARC-AGI-1 puzzles use grids of up to 50x50 cells.
statements.correction: ARC-AGI-1 grids are at most 30x30 cells.

statements.text: In OpenAI's InstructGPT paper, people preferred a 1.3B model's outputs over the 175B GPT-3.
LoRA can cut the number of trainable parameters by 10,000 times compared with full fine-tuning of GPT-3.
DeepMind's compute-optimal Chinchilla model has 280 billion parameters.
statements.correction: Chinchilla has 70 billion parameters. Gopher is the 280B model.

statements.text: Microsoft's Phi-3-mini has 3.8 billion parameters.
Google's Gemma 2 comes in 2B, 9B and 27B sizes.
Apple's on-device foundation model has about 30 billion parameters.
statements.correction: Apple's on-device model has about 3 billion parameters.

statements.text: Claude 3.5 Sonnet was the first frontier AI model to offer computer use in public beta.
OpenAI's Operator agent was powered by a model called Computer-Using Agent (CUA).
Project Mariner, a research prototype agent that works in the browser, is from Microsoft.
statements.correction: Project Mariner is from Google DeepMind.

statements.text: GPQA has 448 multiple-choice questions written by experts in biology, physics and chemistry.
The MATH benchmark has 12,500 competition mathematics problems.
GSM8K has 85,000 grade school math word problems.
statements.correction: GSM8K has 8,500 grade school math word problems.

statements.text: SentencePiece, a subword tokenizer library, was developed by Google.
OpenAI's tiktoken library is a fast tokenizer for OpenAI models.
Meta's Llama 3 uses a tokenizer with a vocabulary of 32,000 tokens.
statements.correction: Llama 3 uses a tokenizer with a vocabulary of 128K tokens.

statements.text: Google renamed its Bard chatbot to Gemini.
Microsoft renamed Bing Chat to Copilot.
Amazon's generative AI upgrade to Alexa is called Alexa Pro.
statements.correction: Amazon's upgraded assistant is called Alexa+.

statements.text: The AlphaFold Protein Structure Database holds over 200 million protein structure predictions.
Google DeepMind's GNoME tool discovered 2.2 million new crystals.
AlphaFold 3 was developed by Google DeepMind and Microsoft Research.
statements.correction: AlphaFold 3 was developed by Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs.

statements.text: LiveCodeBench collects new problems from LeetCode, AtCoder and Codeforces.
Aider's polyglot benchmark has 225 coding exercises in six programming languages.
Google's MBPP benchmark has about 9,700 Python programming problems.
statements.correction: MBPP has 974 Python programming problems.

statements.text: Trainium is a chip that AWS built for training AI models.
MTIA is Meta's own family of AI accelerator chips.
The Maia 100 AI accelerator chip was designed by Google.
statements.correction: Maia 100 was designed by Microsoft.

statements.text: Llama 4 Scout supports a context window of 10 million tokens.
Llama 4 Maverick has 17 billion active parameters and 128 experts.
Llama 4 Maverick was distilled from a larger teacher model called Llama 4 Titan.
statements.correction: Maverick was distilled from Llama 4 Behemoth. There is no Llama 4 Titan.

statements.text: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) was introduced in the RoFormer paper.
ALiBi, a way to encode token positions, stands for Attention with Linear Biases.
Grouped-query attention (GQA) was introduced by researchers at Meta.
statements.correction: GQA was introduced by researchers at Google Research.

statements.text: MusicLM, a model that makes music from text, is from Google.
Jukebox, a model that generates music with singing, is from OpenAI.
MusicGen, a model that makes music from text, is from Microsoft.
statements.correction: MusicGen is from Meta, as part of its AudioCraft library.

statements.text: SWE-bench Verified is a set of 500 SWE-bench problems checked by human software engineers.
τ-bench (tau-bench), a benchmark for agents that use tools and talk to users, was made by Sierra.
In the GAIA benchmark paper, GPT-4 with plugins scored higher than human respondents.
statements.correction: In the GAIA paper, humans scored 92% and GPT-4 with plugins scored 15%.

statements.text: The COCO image dataset was first released under the name Microsoft COCO.
LAION-5B was released with 5.85 billion image and text pairs.
ImageNet has more than 140 million images.
statements.correction: ImageNet has more than 14 million images.

statements.text: Google said Gemini Ultra was the first model to beat human experts on MMLU, with a score of 90.0%.
GPT-4 scored 86.4% on MMLU.
Claude 3 Opus scored 91.8% on MMLU.
statements.correction: Claude 3 Opus scored 86.8% on MMLU.

statements.text: RT-2 is a vision-language-action model for robots from Google DeepMind.
π0 (pi-zero) is a robot foundation model from Physical Intelligence.
Helix, a model that controls humanoid robots, is made by Tesla.
statements.correction: Helix is made by Figure AI.

statements.text: DSPy, a framework for programming language models, comes from the Stanford NLP Group.
Hugging Face's smolagents library lets agents write their actions as code.
The AutoGen multi-agent framework was created by Google.
statements.correction: AutoGen was created by Microsoft, with researchers from Penn State and the University of Washington.

statements.text: AlexNet was trained on two GTX 580 GPUs.
Rumelhart, Hinton and Williams described backpropagation in "Learning representations by back-propagating errors".
Long short-term memory (LSTM) networks were introduced by Yann LeCun.
statements.correction: LSTM was introduced by Sepp Hochreiter and Jürgen Schmidhuber.

statements.text: Magistral is Mistral AI's first reasoning model.
Mistral built its Devstral coding model together with All Hands AI.
Mistral's Codestral model was trained on code in about 20 programming languages.
statements.correction: Codestral was trained on more than 80 programming languages.

statements.text: Imagen, a text-to-image diffusion model, was created by the Google Research Brain Team.
Stable Diffusion was built by the CompVis group with Stability AI and Runway.
The FLUX.1 image models are made by Stability AI.
statements.correction: FLUX.1 is made by Black Forest Labs.

statements.text: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) was introduced by researchers at OpenAI.
Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) was introduced in DeepSeek's DeepSeekMath paper.
Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) was introduced by researchers at Google DeepMind.
statements.correction: DPO was introduced by researchers at Stanford University.

statements.text: OpenAI reported that GPT-4 passed a simulated bar exam with a score around the top 10% of test takers.
Google says its Med-PaLM was the first AI to reach the pass mark on US medical licensing exam style questions.
DeepMind's original AlphaCode ranked in the top 5% of competitors in Codeforces contests.
statements.correction: The original AlphaCode ranked in about the top 54% of competitors, close to an average competitor.

statements.text: DeepSeek-R1's code and model weights are licensed under the MIT License.
DeepSeek-V3's full training took 2.788 million H800 GPU hours.
DeepSeek-Coder-V2 supports only 86 programming languages.
statements.correction: DeepSeek-Coder-V2 supports 338 programming languages, up from 86.

statements.text: OpenAI released Triton, an open-source Python-like language for writing GPU code.
Mojo is a programming language created by the AI company Modular.
ROCm is NVIDIA's open-source software stack for GPU programming.
statements.correction: ROCm is AMD's open-source GPU software stack.

statements.text: The "o" in GPT-4o stands for "omni".
LLaVA, a vision-language model, came from the University of Wisconsin–Madison, Microsoft Research and Columbia.
OpenAI said GPT-4o can respond to audio in as little as 2.3 seconds.
statements.correction: GPT-4o can respond to audio in as little as 232 milliseconds.

statements.text: Aurora, a foundation model for weather and the atmosphere, was built by Microsoft.
The Pangu-Weather forecasting model was built by Huawei Cloud.
In DeepMind's tests, GraphCast was less accurate than ECMWF's HRES forecast on most of 1,380 test targets.
statements.correction: GraphCast was more accurate than HRES on 90% of the 1,380 test targets.

statements.text: The Chatbot Arena paper came from researchers at UC Berkeley, Stanford and UC San Diego.
MT-Bench has 80 multi-turn questions for testing chat assistants.
In Chatbot Arena's battle mode, the names of the two models are shown before people vote.
statements.correction: In battle mode, the two models stay anonymous until after the vote.

statements.text: RoBERTa, an improved version of BERT, came from Facebook AI.
XLNet was developed by researchers at Carnegie Mellon University and Google.
DistilBERT is 40% smaller than BERT and keeps 79% of its language understanding.
statements.correction: DistilBERT keeps 97% of BERT's language understanding.

statements.text: Anthropic's first Responsible Scaling Policy defined AI Safety Levels, or ASLs.
Google DeepMind's Frontier Safety Framework introduced Critical Capability Levels.
The UK's AI Security Institute was previously called the AI Standards Institute.
statements.correction: Before it was renamed, it was called the AI Safety Institute.

statements.text: Claude Sonnet 4.5 scored 61.4% on the OSWorld computer-use benchmark.
Anthropic said Claude Sonnet 4.5 can keep focus on complex tasks for more than 30 hours.
Anthropic launched Claude Opus 4 and Claude Sonnet 4 together with Claude Haiku 4.
statements.correction: There is no Claude Haiku 4. Claude 4 launched as Opus 4 and Sonnet 4, and the next Haiku was Haiku 4.5.

statements.text: FAISS, a library for vector similarity search, was built by Meta's FAIR team.
ColBERT, a retrieval model built on BERT, came from Stanford University.
Sentence-BERT was developed by researchers at Google.
statements.correction: Sentence-BERT was developed at the UKP Lab of TU Darmstadt.

statements.text: FrontierMath, a benchmark of very hard math problems, was created by Epoch AI.
GSM-Symbolic, a variant of the GSM8K math benchmark, was made by Apple researchers.
The miniF2F benchmark has 4,880 formal Olympiad-level math problems.
statements.correction: miniF2F has 488 problems.

statements.text: Devin, an autonomous AI software engineer, is made by Cognition.
Cursor, the AI code editor, is made by a company called Anysphere.
v0, the AI app builder, is made by Netlify.
statements.correction: v0 is made by Vercel.

statements.text: OLMo, a fully open language model, is made by the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2).
IBM makes the Granite family of open models.
The Nemotron family of models is made by AMD.
statements.correction: Nemotron is made by NVIDIA.

statements.text: Qwen3-235B-A22B has 235 billion total parameters and 22 billion active parameters.
Qwen3 launched with support for 119 languages and dialects.
Qwen3 was pretrained on about 3.6 trillion tokens.
statements.correction: Qwen3 was pretrained on about 36 trillion tokens.

statements.text: PagedAttention, the attention algorithm behind vLLM, was inspired by virtual memory in operating systems.
GPTQ can compress the weights of GPT models down to 3 or 4 bits each.
Speculative decoding speeds up text generation, but it changes the model's outputs.
statements.correction: Speculative decoding speeds up generation without changing the model's outputs.

statements.text: Anthropic made Golden Gate Claude by turning up a Golden Gate Bridge feature inside the model.
OpenAI used GPT-4 to write explanations for neurons in GPT-2.
Gemma Scope, a set of sparse autoencoders for Gemma 2, was released by Anthropic.
statements.correction: Gemma Scope was released by Google DeepMind.

statements.text: xAI's Grok-1 has 314 billion parameters.
Google's PaLM model has 540 billion parameters.
Falcon 180B was trained on 35 trillion tokens.
statements.correction: Falcon 180B was trained on 3.5 trillion tokens.

statements.text: LLaMA, the name of Meta's first Llama model, stood for Large Language Model Meta AI.
LoRA stands for Low-Rank Adaptation.
The "TPU" in Google's TPU chips stands for Tensor Parallel Unit.
statements.correction: TPU stands for Tensor Processing Unit.
